methodology.publication_rule: Exact live linear channel, real decode, no loop, and playable from a cloud-hosted M3U without this Mac

latest_audit.source_rotation: Fresh ParaTV/France Télévisions SSAI and simulcast outputs, current M6+ account/Apple TV terms, CANAL+ live distribution, netplus Switzerland, official broadcaster pages, and maintained public resolvers
latest_audit.published_regression: All 12 published channels passed all 36 independent audio/video decode attempts at or above their quality floors; every attempt also produced multiple distinct separated frame hashes.
evidence: ParaTV changed to commit 9563460c at 18:26 UTC during this run. Its newly signed France 2, France 3, and France 5 simulcast renditions still return HTTP 403 at the media-manifest boundary from the US; the alternate SSAI media playlists return 200 but every tested current segment returns 403. This is fresh evidence, not a stale failure.

ParaTV's refreshed CStar wrapper contains a current signed Dailymotion rendition, but Dailymotion's owner-controlled endpoint independently states that x5gv5v0 is unavailable in the United States. Publishing the resolver token would bypass that explicit territory decision, so it remains rejected.

M6+'s July 2026 terms confirm that live M6, W9, and 6ter are free within M6+ but require an M6+ account and supported application, including the Apple TV app. The refreshed resolver set still exposes no portable authorized non-DRM manifest for IPTVX, while the exact M6/W9/6ter netplus feeds remain marked and enforced as Switzerland-only.

CANAL+'s current Apple TV and channel pages continue to place the exact full Canal+ service inside the authenticated paid CANAL+ application. The only open resolver is Canal+ en clair, which is not the exact full linear target.

The refreshed resolver exposes no new exact M6 or W9 source outside licensed account-bound services and still has no 6ter resolver. France 2, France 3, France 5, M6, W9, 6ter, full Canal+, and CStar therefore remain unpublished rather than being replaced by inexact, DRM, or geo-bypassed variants.
latest_audit.result: No newly viable legal exact non-DRM feed was found; the published playlist remains 12 of 20.

channels.name: TF1

channels.name: France 2
channels.reason: France.tv exposes an SSAI manifest, but its media segments return 403 from the US; a fresh 2026-07-25 extraction again returned a current AES-128 playlist while real decoding failed on the protected media/key request. Free TV's exact France 2 service (201) was also audited: every tested HLS audio/video rendition is SAMPLE-AES/FairPlay encrypted and its player requires account and TV-rights tokens for the license request. Molotov Basic carries the exact channel, but its current public state marks it unavailable from the US; channel APIs require an authenticated session and Molotov confirms its delivery uses DRM. Licensed Swiss provider netplus carries exact France 2, but its HLS origin completes TLS and then returns no HTTP response from the US; Teleboy and Salt likewise require Swiss service/account access. POST Luxembourg's 2026-07-24 catalog and Zattoo Switzerland both carry exact France 2, but POST requires its Internet+TV subscription and decoder before Apple TV access, while Zattoo prohibits Swiss live TV outside Switzerland and blocks hosting/proxy use. ParaTV's freshly regenerated exact wrapper still yielded no decodable media from the US. The current maintained public resolver otherwise offers only an untrusted private-IP restream, and Samsung TV Plus's current French FAST catalog contains no exact France 2.

channels.name: M6
channels.reason: M6+ and Free TV's exact M6 service (613) both deliver protected playback. A fresh 2026-07-25 audit found M6's former clear official HLS path now returns CloudFront 403; the still-readable official HLS master declares SAMPLE-AES with com.apple.streamingkeydelivery/FairPlay, and the account-independent M6+ middleware live call returns an empty result. Free TV's current master is public, but every tested audio/video rendition is likewise SAMPLE-AES/FairPlay encrypted and the player requires account and TV-rights tokens for its license request. Molotov distributes M6 only in paid offers; its current US-facing page marks the channel unavailable, its API requires authentication, and Molotov confirms its delivery uses DRM. POST Luxembourg's 2026-07-24 base package carries exact M6 but requires a POST Internet+TV subscription and decoder before Apple TV access. Zattoo and netplus carry M6 Suisse/M6 CH rather than the exact French feed. ParaTV's stale clear M6 wrapper yielded no decodable media, while other current maintained resolvers offer only private-IP restreams. Samsung TV Plus's current French FAST catalog contains no exact M6. An ordinary IPTVX M3U entry cannot decode these sources.

channels.name: Canal+
channels.reason: The full linear channel requires a paid CANAL+ entitlement and DRM. Free TV exposes only a CANAL+ fallback service (1024), not an entitlement-free full linear feed; its HLS is SAMPLE-AES/FairPlay and its DASH is Widevine-protected. Molotov's catalog entry likewise does not expose an entitlement-free full linear source and its channel API requires authentication. netplus and current French operator catalogs explicitly separate CANAL+ free-view windows from the paid full CANAL+ service, while POST Luxembourg and Zattoo's current lineups do not provide the full channel. ParaTV's full-channel resolver currently serves only an unavailable placeholder; its working official-CDN resolver is explicitly CANAL+ en clair and therefore not the full linear service. Samsung TV Plus's current French FAST catalog contains no exact CANAL+. No legitimate direct IPTVX-compatible M3U source exists.

channels.name: CStar
channels.reason: CStar's official Dailymotion live x5gv5v0 is explicitly geo-restricted outside its licensed territories; a fresh 2026-07-25 extraction was again refused by the owner's territory policy. Free TV's exact CStar service (678) was also audited, but every tested HLS audio/video rendition is SAMPLE-AES/FairPlay encrypted and its player requires account and TV-rights tokens for the license request. Molotov Basic carries the exact channel, but its current public state marks it unavailable from the US; channel APIs require an authenticated session and Molotov confirms its delivery uses DRM. POST Luxembourg's 2026-07-24 base package and Zattoo Switzerland carry exact CStar, but POST requires its Internet+TV subscription and decoder, while Zattoo prohibits Swiss live TV outside Switzerland and blocks hosting/proxy use. Licensed Swiss provider netplus carries exact CStar, but its HLS origin completes TLS and then returns no HTTP response from the US; Teleboy and Salt likewise require Swiss service/account access. ParaTV's newly refreshed signed Dailymotion wrapper passed three 12-second H.264/AAC decodes and showed exact CStar branding from the US, but the token is sourced from an owner-permitted territory and would circumvent Dailymotion's explicit US restriction, so it was intentionally not published. Other maintained resolvers offer only private-IP restreams, and Samsung TV Plus's current French FAST catalog contains no exact CStar. The previously published signed Dailymotion rendition expired and was removed rather than left as a dead channel.
